comment: Firestore rules are NOT deployed by CI, by a Netlify build, or by merging a PR. This file is the repo's record of what has actually been released, so the gap between the two cannot be held silently. tests/static/firestore-rules-deploy.test.mjs enforces it; scripts/firestore-rules-status.mjs prints and updates it.

lastConfirmedDeploy.how: npx -y firebase-tools@15.27.0 deploy --only firestore:rules --project shevato-site, recorded in apps/maptap-rivals/README.md

awaitingDeploy: PR #538 (997c9891, 2026-09-13) changed firestore.rules by 76 insertions and 12 deletions and no deploy has been recorded since 2026-09-08. It is security hardening, not cosmetics: maptapRivalsHandles get/list were narrowed after audit R-3 found the handle directory readable and listable by ANY signed-in user (Arena anonymous guests included), which enumerated every claimed handle with its uid; memberResume was bounded so one resume cannot move questionStartedAt backwards or park it; memberRematch was bounded so one member cannot pre-accept for everyone; chat create gained a field allowlist, a 20-character displayName cap and the expiresAt the TTL policy needs. Run the deploy command above, then `node scripts/firestore-rules-status.mjs --record-deployed`.
